questions.stem: How many comparisons does bubble sort make in the worst case for an array of 5 elements?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort makes $\frac{n(n-1)}{2}$ comparisons in the worst case. For 5 elements, this is $\frac{5 \times 4}{2} = 10$ comparisons.
